description: For positive finite n, k, and m, there is a finite N at least m such that every k-colouring of the n-element subsets of the N-element initial segment has a homogeneous subset of exactly m elements.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.finite_ramsey {n k m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (hk : 0 < k) (_hm : 0 < m) :
  ∃ N, m ≤ N ∧ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.FiniteRamseyProperty N n k m
